title: iris florentina var. alba
intro: Iris florentina var. alba, commonly known as Orris root, is a white flowering plant that belongs to the iris family and is native to the mountainous regions of Europe. It has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Iris florentina var. alba include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, making it useful for treating anxiety, insomnia, and menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridin, isoiridin, and other glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
